# Load libraries




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
```
:::




# Load figures




::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
alpha <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/alpha_diversity_MS_plot.rds")

beta <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/beta-diversity-Depth-plot.rds")

core_abund <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/upset_surface_plot.rds")

da_tax <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/DA_heatmap_surface.rds")

alpha_all_depths <- readRDS("rds/Depth_comparison/alpha_diversity_Depths_by_system_plot.rds")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
#Combine  plots

# alphas <- plot_grid(alpha_all_depths, alpha,
#                       labels = c("A)", "B)"), ncol = 2, 
#                       rel_heights = 0.75, 0.25)

beta_core <- plot_grid(beta, core_abund,
                      labels = c("C)", "D)"), ncol = 1,
                      rel_heights = c(0.4, 0.6))

all <- plot_grid(alpha_all_depths, alpha, beta_core, da_tax,
                 labels = c("A)", "B)", "", "E)"), ncol = 4, 
                 rel_widths = c(0.25,0.17, 0.34, 0.30))

# show
all
```
